subject: spring-foot penguin
requested_medium: knitted wool and carved wood toy
art_direction: 厚毛线企鹅立在短木弹簧形底座上，宽嘴与小翅相反差，深紫黄绿配色。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create a penguin toy with a thick knitted plum body, a chartreuse belly patch, and a broad felt beak. Its feet are replaced by one short carved wooden coil that looks stable and springy without being a real mechanism. Lean the body forward and open one tiny wing as if it has an urgent opinion. Show chunky stitches, felt edges, and the wood grain inside the coil. Use a muted teal background and a clear compact silhouette, with no snow landscape, plastic eyes, or repeated plush-toy grin. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
